tools.name: chargeover_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (companies that are billed). Filterable fields: customer_id, parent_customer_id, bill_state, ship_state, bill_country, ship_country, external_key, token, company, superuser_id, superuser_email, customer_status_state (a = active, i = inactive), customer_status_str (active-current, acti

tools.name: chargeover_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (the people at customers; the API calls them users). Filterable fields: user_id, external_key, first_name, last_name, email, phone, user_type_id, username, customers.customer_id (contacts of one customer). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /user.

tools.name: chargeover_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with status, totals, credits, payments and balance. Filterable fields: invoice_id, refnumber, customer_id, invoice_status_str (open-unpaid, open-overdue, open-collections, closed-void, closed-paid), invoice_status_state (o = open, c = closed), package_id, package_token, date, currency_

tools.name: chargeover_list_transactions
tools.description: List transactions (payments, refunds and credits that already happened; this tool only reads them). Filterable fields: transaction_id, customer_id, gateway_id, currency_id, creditcard_id, ach_id, tokenized_id, token, external_key, gateway_status, gateway_transid, amount, fee, transaction_type, trans

tools.name: chargeover_list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes (proposals for a customer or lead; the list has no line items, get one quote for those). Filterable fields: quote_id, customer_id, brand_id, currency_id, refnumber, token, external_key, date, bill_state, bill_country, quote_status_str (open-new, open-sent, closed-won, closed-lost), quote

tools.name: chargeover_list_subscriptions
tools.description: List subscriptions (the API calls them packages): recurring billing plans of customers. Filterable fields: package_id, customer_id, token, brand_id, paymethod, paycycle (mon, qtr, yrl...), nickname, package_status_state (a active, c cancelled, e expired, s suspended), package_status_str (active-tria

tools.name: chargeover_list_items
tools.description: List items: the products, services and discounts that go on invoices, quotes and subscriptions, with their pricing tiers. Filterable fields: item_id, name, external_key, accounting_sku, item_type (service or discount), custom_1, custom_2, custom_3. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /item.

tools.name: chargeover_list_notes
tools.description: List notes attached to customers, subscriptions, invoices, contacts, quotes and items. Filterable fields: context_str (customer, billing_package, invoice, user, quote, item), context_id. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /note.

tools.name: chargeover_list_usage
tools.description: List usage (metered billing) data points recorded against subscription line items. Filterable fields: line_item_id, external_key, from (date), to (date). Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /usage.

tools.name: chargeover_list_coupons
tools.description: List coupons (code, description, type, enabled, linked discount item). Filterable fields: none documented; the list is small. Paged: pass next_offset as offset. GET /coupon.

tools.name: chargeover_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by customer_id: company, status, addresses, primary contact, terms, balance fields, custom fields. GET /customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact (user) by user_id: name, email, phone, username, the customers they belong to. GET /user/{user_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by invoice_id: status, line items, totals, balance, payments and credits applied, billing address. GET /invoice/{invoice_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one transaction (payment, refund or credit that already happened) by transaction_id: amount, method, status, the invoices it was applied to, related refunds. GET /transaction/{transaction_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_quote
tools.description: Get one quote by quote_id: status, line items, totals, memo, links to the invoice or subscription it became. GET /quote/{quote_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription (package) by package_id: status, payment cycle, pay method, next invoice date, line items. GET /package/{package_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_get_item
tools.description: Get one item (product, service or discount) by item_id: name, type, SKU, pricing tiers per currency. GET /item/{item_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_list_reports
tools.description: List the account's saved reports (report_id and name). Run one with chargeover_run_report. GET /_report.

tools.name: chargeover_get_report
tools.description: A report's name, its available_filters (field names and allowed operators), available_columns and default_columns. Read this before chargeover_run_report to know which filters and columns to use. GET /_report/{report_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_run_report
tools.description: Run a saved report and return its rows (read only; nothing is changed). Filters use the report's own field names from chargeover_get_report, for example [{field:'transaction_transaction_date',op:'GTE',value:'2026-01-01'}]. Operators vary by field (dates GTE/LTE/EQUALS, ids EQUALS, strings CONTAINS/D

tools.name: chargeover_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer (no charge, no invoice, no email is sent by this call). Returns the new customer_id. Add a primary contact with the superuser_* fields. Use chargeover_list_customers first to avoid a duplicate (external_key is unique). POST /customer.

tools.name: chargeover_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer; send only the fields to change. Cannot touch payment methods, balances or status. Replaces the previous values of the fields you send. PUT /customer/{customer_id}.

tools.name: chargeover_create_contact
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (person) to an existing customer. No email is sent by this call. Returns the new user_id. POST /user.

tools.name: chargeover_create_note
tools.description: WRITE: add a note to a customer, subscription, invoice, contact, quote or item (shown in the ChargeOver UI to the team; never sent to the customer). Returns the note id. POST /note.

tools.name: chargeover_create_quote
tools.description: WRITE: create a quote (a proposal) for an existing customer. Nothing is billed and no email is sent: the quote stays open until someone sends or accepts it in ChargeOver. Each line refers to an existing item (chargeover_list_items). paycycle: one = one-time invoice, mon = monthly, 2mn = every 2 mont

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: chargeover_list_contacts, chargeover_list_subscriptions, chargeover_get_contact, chargeover_run_report, chargeover_create_quote · Private data: chargeover_list_customers, chargeover_list_contacts, chargeover_list_invoices, chargeover_list_transactions, chargeover_list_quotes, chargeover_list_subscriptions, chargeover_list_notes, chargeover_get_customer, chargeover_get_contact, chargeover_create_customer, chargeover_create_contact, chargeover_create_note · Public sink: chargeover_list_contacts, chargeover_list_subscriptions, chargeover_get_contact, chargeover_run_report, chargeover_create_customer, chargeover_update_customer, chargeover_create_contact, chargeover_create_note, chargeover_create_quote · Destructive: chargeover_list_reports, chargeover_run_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: chargeover_list_contacts, chargeover_list_subscriptions, chargeover_get_contact, chargeover_run_report, chargeover_create_quote · Private data: chargeover_list_customers, chargeover_list_contacts, chargeover_list_invoices, chargeover_list_transactions, chargeover_list_quotes, chargeover_list_subscriptions, chargeover_list_notes, chargeover_get_customer, chargeover_get_contact, chargeover_create_customer, chargeover_create_contact, chargeover_create_note · Public sink: chargeover_list_contacts, chargeover_list_subscriptions, chargeover_get_contact, chargeover_run_report, chargeover_create_customer, chargeover_update_customer, chargeover_create_contact, chargeover_create_note, chargeover_create_quote · Destructive: chargeover_list_reports, chargeover_run_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
